candidates.name: surreal-memory REST API (POST /api/v1/memory)

maintenance.notes: the same REST API the in-repo prometheus-cli client uses

evidence.claim: SurrealMemoryClient uses /health, /api/v1/entities, /api/v1/search — plain REST, no SSE

risks: REST AddMemoryRequest omits metadata/importance fields the MCP tool accepts — confirm bridge only needs content+user_id
candidates.decision_rationale: ADOPT for the primary add_memory write path. A fire-and-forget bash POST works directly — no SSE session. Dissolves the assessment's hard problem; no new code/tool needed beyond re-pointing the bridge.

candidates.name: prometheus memory add (new Rust CLI subcommand)

evidence.claim: prometheus-cli is NOT a submodule — editable in this repo
client already has create_entity/search over REST; an add_memory method is a ~10-line addition

risks: requires a Rust rebuild + re-sign (macOS SIGKILL); heavier than the bash REST fix
candidates.decision_rationale: REFERENCE, not adopt-now. A durable shell-side writer (covers task-streams too via the MCP client), but the bash REST fix is sufficient and lighter for the hook use case. Revisit if unattended task-stream writes become needed.

candidates.name: bash SSE session handshake in _mem_call

evidence.claim: GET /mcp/sse session + POST /mcp/messages?sessionId — holding an SSE stream open in bash is fragile

risks: exactly the fragility the outbox exists to avoid
candidates.decision_rationale: REJECT — unnecessary now that a plain REST route exists. Would reintroduce the complexity the outbox was built to dodge.

candidates.name: agent-drained outbox
risks: only drains when an agent session runs
candidates.decision_rationale: ADAPT as the fallback for the MCP-tool-only writes (task-streams) that have no REST route, and as the drain mechanism for any REST-4xx-buffered add_memory lines. Secondary to the REST fix.

candidates.name: direct SurrealDB write on :28000
candidates.decision_rationale: REJECT — bypasses the embedding/scoping/dedup the MCP+REST layer provides; would store unembedded rows semantic_search can't find.

build_required.need: Fix memory-outbox-flush.sh to drain via the REST route (add_memory) and handle task-stream lines (no REST route)
